author: Bobby Grayson
description: 'elixir elixir/test/run_fixtures.exs | grep -v "^PASS "' reports GREP's exit status, and grep exits 0 exactly when there are FAIL lines to print, so under 'set -e' a fixture failure printed its FAIL lines and check.sh carried on. Demonstrated: sh -c 'set -e; (echo FAIL; exit 1) | grep -v "^PASS "; echo CONTINUED' prints CONTINUED. Fixed for both the existing fixture runner and the new land_real self-test by capturing the output to $OUT and making a non-zero exit fatal before the PASS lines are dropped.
title: check.sh had a hole: a failing fixture run could not fail the gate
